svg.text: 04 Centre back, table and makeup shelves
TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Fit the TWO centre Back panels between the tall units; seam is behind the TV.
2. Fit Table Top at 720 mm and TV Ledge top at 1300 mm, using their modelled supports.
3. Fit Divider at the drawer-tower edge, then the two Makeup Shelves to its right.
4. TV bracket bolts must reach suitable wall structure; plywood alone is not the fixing.
5. Keep all DC cables behind shelves and away from drawer and hinge travel.
